direct_trader_corrections.rule: Replay cases used to calibrate TP marking must present meaningful higher and lower structure so the trader can independently mark both bullish and bearish TP plans before direction is known.
direct_trader_corrections.implementation: Use materially deeper 15m/5m causal history and prefer cases with at least one meaningful reaction destination above and one below the decision price. Do not fabricate a level when one side truly has no meaningful reaction.

direct_trader_corrections.rule: A trader TP may legitimately be placed at the middle of an active 15m FVG when that FVG is the first meaningful reaction used as the target.
direct_trader_corrections.implementation: TP fidelity grading must preserve 15m FVG midpoint semantics. FVG is reaction/TP context; it does not become a requirement for displacement entry.

direct_trader_corrections.rule: The next calibration pack must show substantially more real 5-minute momentum/force opportunities so the trader can demonstrate entries he would actually take.
direct_trader_corrections.implementation: Prioritize distinct-session authoritative entries first, then genuine candle-story + force candidates rejected only by later room/TP gates, before any generic no-entry controls. Use every available qualifying momentum case up to the pack limit rather than filling with quiet controls.

direct_trader_corrections.rule: WAIT remains a distinct trader state at the end of the presented replay window and must never be silently converted to NO_TRADE.
direct_trader_corrections.implementation: Preserve WAIT exactly for fidelity comparison.

direct_trader_corrections.rule: The trader enters from the 5-minute chart. The 1-minute view was supplied only because the bot uses completed 1-minute observations to reconstruct intrabar behavior causally.
direct_trader_corrections.implementation: The trader-facing replay must make 5m the primary entry/decision chart. 15m remains higher-timeframe structure/FVG/TP context. Any 1m panel is diagnostic only and must not be presented as the trader's entry timeframe. The bot may use completed 1m bars internally to rebuild the still-forming 5m candle at exact decision clocks without hindsight.

sampling.reason: This is calibration, not blind or clean edge evidence.
